name: quick_observability
description:
Answer any question about an Amazon Quick environment by running ONE read-only Athena (Presto/Trino) SQL query over the Quick observability data lake and returning the rows. Translate the user's natural-language question into SQL against the tables below, then call this tool. Supports SELECT, WITH, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN only; no semicolons/multiple statements; no writes.

GLUE DATABASE: quick_observability (already the default; use bare table names).

TABLES (name(column:type, ...)):
- chat_events(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, user_type:string, status_code:string, conversation_id:string, system_message_id:string, message_scope:string, user_message_id:string, user_message:string, agent_id:string, flow_id:string, system_text_message:string, resource_arn:string, selected_resource_id:string, selected_resource_type:string, action_connector_id:string, cited_resource_type:string, cited_resource_id:string, cited_resource_name:string, file_attachment_type:string, file_attachment_name:string) -- one row per chat message/query.
- feedback_events(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, user_type:string, status_code:string, conversation_id:string, system_message_id:string, user_message_id:string, feedback_type:string, feedback_reason:string, feedback_details:string, resource_arn:string) -- thumbs up/down. feedback_type values like 'Useful'/'Not Useful'.
- agent_hours(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, subscription_type:string, reporting_service:string, usage_group:string, usage_hours:double, service_resource_arn:string, resource_arn:string) -- agent-hours consumption. subscription_type in (ENTERPRISE, PROFESSIONAL); reporting_service in (FLOW, AUTOMATION, RESEARCH, ...); usage_group in (Included=within entitlement, Extra=overage); service_resource_arn identifies the specific flow/automation/research session (the 'agent'); usage_hours is decimal hours.
- agent_metadata(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, event_name:string, event_version:string, agent_id:string, agent_arn:string, agent_name:string, agent_status:string, request_id:string, description:string, update_action:string, version:string, icon_id:string, space_arn:string, resource_arn:string) -- agent create/update/delete.
- index_usage(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, source_type:string, source_name:string, source_arn:string, consumed_index_size:bigint, consumed_source_size:bigint, consumed_source_doc_count:bigint, resource_arn:string) -- per-user storage consumed (bytes).
- kb_file_sync(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, document_id:string, document_title:string, document_status:string, sync_result:string, sync_id:string, data_source_id:string, source_uri:string, error_message:string, error_mitigation:string, error_type:string, knowledge_base_id:string, resource_arn:string) -- knowledge-base document sync.
- dlp_events(event_timestamp:bigint, account_id:string, user_arn:string, event_type:string, request_id:string, dlp_job_id:string, dlp_setting_id:string, policy_action:string, file_name:string, file_size:bigint, failure_type:string, policy_message:string, dlp_setting_name:string, status:string, provider_type:string, auth_type:string, provider_outage_mode:string, unmapped_action:string, last_updated_by:string, resource_arn:string) -- data-loss-prevention policy actions.
- cloudtrail_events(event_time:bigint, event_id:string, event_name:string, event_source:string, event_category:string, aws_region:string, user_name:string, user_identity_type:string, user_identity_arn:string, on_behalf_of_user_id:string, source_ip_address:string, user_agent:string, read_only:boolean, error_code:string, error_message:string, resource_type:string, resource_name:string, action_connector_id:string, action_id:string, end_user_arn:string, invoke_action_status:string, invoke_http_status_code:string) -- audit trail (management events + InvokeAction connector data events). NOTE time column is event_time (not event_timestamp).
- metric_snapshots(snapshot_timestamp:bigint, metric_group:string, metric_name:string, statistic:string, value:double, unit:string, dashboard_id:string, dataset_id:string, sheet_id:string, visual_id:string, knowledge_base_id:string, quick_instance_id:string, action_connector_id:string, action_connector_type:string, action_id:string, automation_id:string, invoke_error_code:string) -- periodic AWS/QuickSight CloudWatch metric snapshots. metric_name examples: DashboardViewCount, IngestionInvocationCount, DocumentsIndexed, ActionInvocationCount, TotalAutomationRunCount, SPICECapacityConsumedInMB, SPICECapacityLimitInMB. NOTE time column is snapshot_timestamp.

CONVENTIONS (important):
1. There is NO username/email column. A user is identified by user_arn, e.g. 'arn:aws:quicksight:us-east-1:111122223333:user/default/vineet'. To filter by a person's name, use user_arn LIKE '%<name>%' (e.g. WHERE user_arn LIKE '%vineet%'). cloudtrail_events also has user_name, user_identity_arn, on_behalf_of_user_id.
2. All time columns are epoch SECONDS stored as bigint. Convert to a timestamp with from_unixtime(event_timestamp). For a relative window use: event_timestamp >= to_unixtime(current_timestamp - interval '30' day). For 'today' use event_timestamp >= to_unixtime(current_date). Time columns: cloudtrail_events uses event_time; metric_snapshots uses snapshot_timestamp; all other tables use event_timestamp.
3. Aggregate agent hours with SUM(usage_hours). For per-agent use GROUP BY service_resource_arn; per-user GROUP BY user_arn; Included vs Extra GROUP BY usage_group; per surface GROUP BY reporting_service.
4. Prefer SUM/COUNT/AVG with explicit column aliases and ORDER BY, and add a LIMIT for row-returning queries.

QUANTITATIVE vs QUALITATIVE: This tool answers BOTH. For quantitative questions (how many, totals, averages, trends) use aggregates (COUNT/SUM/AVG, COUNT(DISTINCT ...), GROUP BY, date_trunc for trends). For qualitative questions (what did users say, why thumbs-down, what errors, what content) SELECT the text columns and show representative rows: chat content in chat_events.user_message / system_text_message; feedback rationale in feedback_events.feedback_type / feedback_reason / feedback_details; failures in chat_events.status_code, kb_file_sync.error_message / error_type, dlp_events.policy_action / policy_message, cloudtrail_events.error_code / error_message. Combine both when useful (e.g. counts plus a few example messages).

EXAMPLES:
- Agent hours used by vineet this month: SELECT SUM(usage_hours) AS total_agent_hours FROM agent_hours WHERE user_arn LIKE '%vineet%' AND event_timestamp >= to_unixtime(date_trunc('month', current_date))
- Vineet's agent hours broken down per agent (with Included/Extra): SELECT service_resource_arn, reporting_service, usage_group, SUM(usage_hours) AS hours FROM agent_hours WHERE user_arn LIKE '%vineet%' AND event_timestamp >= to_unixtime(date_trunc('month', current_date)) GROUP BY service_resource_arn, reporting_service, usage_group ORDER BY hours DESC
- Active users this week plus conversations and queries: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_arn) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT conversation_id) AS conversations, COUNT(*) AS queries FROM chat_events WHERE event_timestamp >= to_unixtime(current_timestamp - interval '7' day)
- Users consuming the most storage: SELECT user_arn, SUM(consumed_source_size) AS source_bytes, SUM(consumed_index_size) AS index_bytes, SUM(consumed_source_doc_count) AS docs FROM index_usage GROUP BY user_arn ORDER BY source_bytes DESC
- Who created/updated/deleted dashboards and datasets in the last 7 days: SELECT from_unixtime(event_time) AS t, event_name, user_name, user_identity_arn, resource_type, resource_name, error_code FROM cloudtrail_events WHERE event_time >= to_unixtime(current_timestamp - interval '7' day) AND (event_name LIKE '%Dashboard%' OR event_name LIKE '%DataSet%' OR event_name LIKE '%Dataset%') ORDER BY t DESC
- SPICE consumed vs limit trend over 30 days: SELECT date_trunc('day', from_unixtime(snapshot_timestamp)) AS day, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='SPICECapacityConsumedInMB' THEN value END) AS consumed_mb, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name='SPICECapacityLimitInMB' THEN value END) AS limit_mb FROM metric_snapshots WHERE metric_name IN ('SPICECapacityConsumedInMB','SPICECapacityLimitInMB') AND snapshot_timestamp >= to_unixtime(current_timestamp - interval '30' day) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY day
- Qualitative: why users left thumbs-down: SELECT feedback_reason, COUNT(*) AS n FROM feedback_events WHERE feedback_type = 'Not Useful' GROUP BY feedback_reason ORDER BY n DESC; and example details: SELECT from_unixtime(event_timestamp) AS t, user_arn, feedback_reason, feedback_details FROM feedback_events WHERE feedback_type = 'Not Useful' ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 20
- Qualitative: what errors are users hitting: SELECT from_unixtime(event_timestamp) AS t, user_arn, status_code, user_message FROM chat_events WHERE status_code <> 'success' ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 50
- List tables: SHOW TABLES. Columns of a table (e.g. what fields are in chat logs): DESCRIBE chat_events.

Keywords: agent hours per user, agent hours per agent, storage per user, last login, active users, DAU WAU MAU, audit, who did what, metric trend, SPICE usage, deep analysis, SQL, Athena, custom query.

sql.description: A single read-only Athena (Presto/Trino) statement (SELECT/WITH/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN). Use bare table names (database quick_observability is the default). No trailing semicolon, no multiple statements.

name: export_user_data
description: Admin-run DSAR / data-portability export for ONE user. Gathers that user's rows across the observability pipeline tables (chat_events, feedback_events, agent_hours, agent_metadata, index_usage, dlp_events, cloudtrail_events) into a single portable JSON bundle, writes it to the data lake's dsar-exports/ prefix, and returns a short-lived pre-signed download URL. Scope: covers ONLY data captured by this pipeline (the CHAT_LOGS vended stream plus metrics/audit); does NOT include memories, knowledge graph, spaces, agents, or uploaded-file content, which this pipeline does not capture. Chat/response text is present only if the optional CHAT_LOGS content fields are enabled. Use for access/portability requests. Keywords: DSAR, data subject access request, export user data, portability, GDPR, CCPA, right to access, give me a user's data.

user_arn.description: The user to export: full user_arn (e.g. arn:aws:quicksight:...:user/default/vineet) or the bare user name.

max_rows_per_table.description: Optional cap on rows exported per table (default 10000).
